names: Sodium citrates (i) Monosodium citrate (ii) Disodium citrate (iii) Sodium citrate (trisodium citrate)

more_info.overview: E331 covers mono-, di- and trisodium citrate, which are different sodium salts of citric acid. Its acidity-regulating role is to adjust or maintain the pH of the food. One specified form is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. EU permissions include edible caseinates, milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured pasteurised and sterilised (including uht) milk, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat).
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit juices as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable juices; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
